playback_rule: Advance the loop by actual eastward displacement divided by 24 pixels; at 48 pixels/second this yields a 0.5-second cycle. Stop advancing when displacement is zero.
selection_reason: The existing run_east frames lean forward, swing bent arms and trail the coat, which reads as escape more clearly than the upright walk_east. All retain actual east heading. The 48-pixel/second target reduces the current 105-pixel/second mismatch.
limitations: All four frames are broad running-pose variants with limited distinct foot-contact information. The selected source order is conservative; no stronger permutation is visually established.
24 pixels/cycle is a nominal tuning value for native review, not a measured no-slip physical stride.
Frame6 turns the torso more side-on, though heading remains east. Review at room scale before treating this as finished animation.
integration_notes: Begin after the stationary recoil/surrender hold.
Select escape_east or run_east explicitly; generic pose(true,RIGHT) currently selects walk_east and will not use this choice.
Use the same 48-pixel/second value for actual translation and nominal animation calibration; report actual displacement to playback.
